provenance: Original synthetic cases authored for AUDIT-D04; no real manuscript.
purpose: One hand-authored corpus read by two independent checkers. prints/omits are checked against text extracted from PDFs rendered by the pinned helper (tools/pdf-helper/test_helper.py). clean/blockingLines/omissions are checked against Babel's export assessment (tests/contract/export-assessment.test.ts). Whitespace is collapsed before text comparison.
